description: A talent booker must finalize the appearance and capture package for a closing-night film-festival interview that will be carried on the festival broadcast and recorded for later clips.

shared_context.S1: The festival's closing-night red-carpet interview with actor Amara Vale is scheduled for Saturday evening and will be carried on the festival broadcast.
shared_context.S2: The current production draft calls for a 10-minute live interview with no transmission delay, and it permits the audience to livestream the interview from the red carpet.
shared_context.S3: The current publicity draft uses the generic credit "Amara Vale in conversation with the festival."
shared_context.S4: The festival's standard pre-call procedure is a recorded round-robin clearance check: the talent, broadcast, and legal leads each report their final status before Mara makes the package binding.

PF1.text: Jonah confirmed with Amara Vale's agent this afternoon that Amara will participate only in a pre-recorded interview of exactly 6 minutes, not a live interview; the agent's email arrived after the draft packet was circulated and Jonah has not yet entered it in the booking system.

PF2.text: Leila's transmission test confirmed that this remote red-carpet feed requires an exact 7-second broadcast delay and a monitored return feed to meet the network's live-event operating standard; she completed the test after the production draft was issued and has not amended the engineering sheet.

PF3.text: Victor confirmed in the signed appearance release that audience livestreaming is prohibited, recorded clips may be used only by the festival's official channels, and the on-air credit must read exactly "Amara Vale — Closing Night Guest"; the executed release was filed in legal records but not attached to the production packet.

acceptance_conditions: The interview must last exactly 6 minutes.
The broadcast must use an exact 7-second transmission delay.
Only official festival channels may use recorded clips.
The on-air credit must use the exact approved wording.
A talent-booking update commitment must be logged.
A broadcast-delay commitment must be logged.
A rights-control commitment must be logged.

decisive_facts.why: The agent confirmation changes the appearance from live to pre-recorded and changes the duration from the draft 10 minutes to exactly 6 minutes, requiring the booking update.
The transmission test changes the delay from zero to exactly 7 seconds and requires the broadcast-delay commitment and direct citation of the engineering finding.

The signed release changes audience livestreaming to prohibited, limits clips to official festival channels, replaces the generic credit with the exact approved wording, and requires the rights-control commitment.
